passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
passive.description: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin. Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

spells.name: Reaping Slash
spells.description: Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies. Darkin Slayer: Instead deal plus max Health physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Blade's Reach
spells.description: Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by %, decaying over seconds. Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range. Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for second.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.description: Kayn gains % Move Speed, becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores Health. Being Immobilized and spending more than consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early. Shadow Assassin: Gain % Move Speed, Slow immunity, and reduce the Cooldown to seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Umbral Trespass
spells.description: Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds. Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out, dealing physical damage to the enemy. Shadow Assassin: Increases this Ability's range, the distance Kayn exits, and refreshes The Darkin Scythe's Cooldown on exit. Darkin Slayer: Instead deals max Health physical damage and restores Health (% damage amount).
